description: Update site settings: title, keyConvention, editingMode, signature ("Made with dotsy" badge; live immediately), trailingSlash, ownSeoFiles, aiTrain, and the language settings; each field's own description has the details. Slug is the hostname — use rename_site. Set editingMode 'staged' before handing the editor to a person via start_edit_session's draftEditorUrl.

aiTrain.description: Whether AI training crawlers may use the live site. true (the default) allows them. false asks them not to. Live immediately, no publish needed. Same callers who can set trailingSlash can set this.

defaultLanguage.description: The site's main language, a code like "en" (invalid → 400 invalid_language). null removes every language setting. Takes effect at the next publish.

editingMode.description: How the editor's Save behaves. 'live' (default) publishes each save; 'staged' keeps drafts until publish_site. Prefer 'staged' when handing the editor to a person (start_edit_session → draftEditorUrl). API writes always stage.

hreflang.description: "auto" (default) tells search engines which pages are translations of each other; "off" stops that. Takes effect at the next publish.

languages.description: The OTHER languages (not the main one); replaces the list. Needs a main language. Takes effect at the next publish.

image.description: Asset key of a flag or icon the switcher can show.

label.description: Name shown in the switcher (default: the language's own name).

prefix.description: Folder for this language, like "/es" (default "/" + code). null = no folder.

publish.description: false hides this language from translation links, search alternates and the switcher; pages still serve. Default true.

ownSeoFiles.description: Use the site's own robots.txt and sitemap.xml even when they can hurt search: a robots.txt that blocks the whole site (Disallow: /), and a static sitemap.xml, which replaces the generated one (collection pages included). Off by default; a robots.txt without Disallow: / is always used. Takes effect at the next publish.

signature.description: "Made with dotsy" signature badge. Takes effect on the live site immediately, no publish needed.

enabled.description: Show the badge in a bottom corner of every published page.

mark.description: Resting look: 'dot' (senna dot, default) or 'logo' (dotsy logo).

reveal.description: On hover: 'seal' (rotating stamp, default) or 'pill' ("Made with dotsy").

side.description: Preferred bottom corner: 'right' (default) or 'left'. If a chat bubble or bar covers it, the badge moves to the other corner, the bottom centre, or above the bar.

trailingSlash.description: Page URL form. 'ignore' (default): /blog and /blog/ both serve the page. 'never': /blog/ 301s to /blog. 'always': /blog 301s to /blog/. The canonical tag and sitemap use the same form. Live immediately, no publish needed.

name: update_site
